brief: Create the last chart in a coastal voyage. On a 4 by 4 grid, tapping a lantern toggles itself and adjacent orthogonal neighbours. Tapping a relay also toggles its distant partner. Two shuttered stations receive light but cannot be pressed. Choose a relay and a scramble design whose minimum is at least five moves and which requires a relay for an optimal solution. A designer approves the final chart. Give the chosen route a short original English maritime title (1 to 4 words).
